http_request_firewall_custom.description: Managed challenge on the sign-in pages, except for verified search engines
http_request_firewall_custom.expression: (http.host eq "www.example.org" and (starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/login") or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/register")) and not cf.client.bot)

http_request_firewall_custom.description: Block vulnerability scanners by their user agent
http_request_firewall_custom.expression: (http.host in {"www.example.org" "forums.example.org"} and (http.user_agent contains "zgrab" or http.user_agent contains "masscan" or http.user_agent contains "Nuclei" or http.user_agent contains "Nikto"))

http_request_dynamic_redirect.description: The old forum name to the new one, same path and query
The bare domain to www, same path and query
